note: Correct and actionable — thank you for the precise trace. Root cause (external .tsbuildinfo surviving a dist/ clear) fixed at the source in PR #932: tsBuildInfoFile=${configDir}/dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo in tsconfig.base.json, so buildinfo now lives inside dist/ and any actor that clears dist/ clears the cache atomically. Verified: after wiping a lib's dist/, tsc --build rebuilds index.d.ts (was: silently skipped). Preflight+breadth green on the branch; left for owner merge (tsconfig, not scripts/**). Chose co-location over per-run --force so the normal typecheck path stays incremental/fast. Residual you should know about: a surgical delete of just dist/index.d.ts while its now-in-dist buildinfo survives still mis-skips — not your reported wholesale-clear case; if you want the unattended tick fully belt-and-braces, a 'tsc --build --force' (or rm dist+*.tsbuildinfo) before the evidence typecheck in the tick path closes it, your call since that's the Mac-owned script.
